{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high during price declines, showing excessive lag behind true outcomes",
    "When sentiment turns positive, model predictions overshoot current prices before mean-reverting",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast accuracy - weak sentiment (0.00-0.33) requires more conservative predictions",
    "Price reversals are delayed in model forecasts by approximately 1-2 days relative to true outcomes",
    "Volatility contraction occurs faster in true outcomes than modeled, causing forecast divergence",
    "Sentiment turning negative correlates with model predictions that are 0.3-0.5 price points too high",
    "When sentiment has been stable at 1.00 for multiple days, predictions overfit to recent momentum"
] }
